name: Known exploited vulnerabilities (CISA KEV)
owner: CISA (Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, United States)
gives: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency's catalogue of vulnerabilities known to be exploited: each CVE with vendor, product, the day added and ransomware use; and totals per week and vendor, for cyber.promptugal.news's pulse. Products only, never a victim, host or address.
how: sources/cisa-kev/collect.mjs reads https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog (twice a day, at data.b@'s wakes; the source's own cadence: every 6 hours)
